inputs.name: hand over from Data Contracts to Data Ingestion Pipeline

output.level_0: Data ingestion pipeline fails because data contracts are not respected.
output.level_1: No data ingestion pipeline exists to process data contracts.
output.level_2: The team manually checks data contracts before feeding them to the data ingestion pipeline.
output.level_3: A script automatically validates data contracts before passing them to the data ingestion pipeline.
output.level_4: A governed process validates data contracts before ingestion, with audit logs for compliance.
